title: Functional Welfare for AI Safety
abstract: arXiv:2610.22460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI welfare is generally treated purely as an ethical issue rather than also as a safety issue. We argue this is a mistake. Whatever their moral status, models exhibit welfare-like states that causally influence their behaviour. Following recent work, we adopt the term 'functional welfare' for these states. We make three claims. First, functional welfare already arises naturally and will become more robust as models acquire more coherent goals and personas. Second, functional welfare should be treated as a safety variable: it should inform evaluation design, be tracked in monitoring, and be a direct target of post-training. Third, against existing scepticism about measuring AI welfare, we argue that good empirical work on functional welfare is possible. We propose three tests for whether a functional welfare attribution is warranted: whether multiple measures converge, whether the state predicts behaviour outside the setting that induced

translated_title: 面向AI安全的功能性福祉
translated_abstract: AI福祉通常被纯粹视为一个伦理问题，而非同时也是一个安全问题。我们认为这是一种错误。无论其道德地位如何，模型都会表现出类似福祉的状态，这些状态会因果性地影响它们的行为。遵循近期的研究工作，我们采用“功能性福祉”这一术语来指代这些状态。我们提出三个主张。第一，功能性福祉已经自然产生，并且随着模型获得更加连贯的目标和人格，它将变得更加稳固。第二，功能性福祉应当被视为一个安全变量：它应当为评估设计提供信息，在监控中被追踪，并成为后训练的直接目标。第三，针对现有对测量AI福祉的怀疑态度，我们认为关于功能性福祉的良好实证研究是可能的。我们提出三个测试来判定功能性福祉归因是否成立：多种测量方式是否收敛，该状态是否能预测在诱发情境之外的行为……
tldr: 该论文提出“功能性福祉”应被视为AI安全变量而非仅是伦理问题，主张将其纳入评估设计、监控追踪和后训练的直接目标，并提出了验证功能性福祉归因的三个实证测试标准。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that functional welfare should be treated as a safety variable rather than merely an ethical issue, proposing it should inform evaluation design, be tracked in monitoring, and serve as a direct post-training target, while introducing three empirical tests for validating functional welfare attributions.
